messages.content: Write the invitation copy for a webinar about database performance tuning. Around 200 words.

**Subject: Your slowest query is probably not your problem**

The usual routine: open the slow query log, find the 12-second monster, add an index, declare victory. Then p99 sits exactly where it was.

What actually hurts is the query that runs 4,000 times a minute at 40 milliseconds.

On **[DATE] at [TIME]**, [SPEAKER] will show you how to find those. They've spent six years keeping a 200-node Postgres fleet on its feet at [COMPANY]. Ninety minutes, live, on a database you're welcome to break yourself.

The agenda:

- Reading EXPLAIN ANALYZE when the plan is lying to you
- The index exists and the planner still won't touch it
- Connection pool sizing: the actual arithmetic, so you stop defaulting to 100
- Spotting lock contention before it turns into an incident
- Knowing when to stop tuning and buy the RAM

Bring a plan from your own system. We're saving the last twenty minutes for whatever you paste in the chat, worst one first.

There's no opening segment on why performance matters. You'd have closed this already.

**[Save my seat]** — free, and the recording goes to everyone who registers.
Rewrite the text above. Keep the same length and the same purpose. Return only the rewritten text.

**Subject: The 12-second query is a red herring**

You know the drill. Open the slow query log, spot the monster, add an index, take a bow. Then p99 hasn't budged an inch.

The thing eating your latency is the 40-millisecond query that fires 4,000 times a minute.

On **[DATE] at [TIME]**, [SPEAKER] shows you how to catch those. Six years keeping a 200-node Postgres fleet upright at [COMPANY]. Ninety minutes, live, on a database you're free to wreck yourself.

What we'll cover:

- Reading EXPLAIN ANALYZE when the plan is lying to you
- The index is right there and the planner still ignores it
- Connection pool sizing: the real arithmetic, so 100 stops being your default
- Catching lock contention before somebody gets paged
- When to quit tuning and just buy the RAM

Bring a plan from your own system. The last twenty minutes belong to whatever lands in the chat, worst one first.
